title: Johnny Dodds's hobbies and first hearing him with Oliver
summary: Dodds loved sweets and the White Sox; Dominique first heard him at the Royal Garden with Oliver, and praises Baby Dodds's speed.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Is there anything else you could tell about Johnny? What kind of a person he was? What his hobbies were? And what else he did?
Well, Johnny's hobby was eating a lot of sweets.
He ate a lot of sweets.
What about any sports? Did he follow anything? Baseball.

White Sox fan. He died a White Sox fan. He didn't think there was another team in the whole world like the White Sox. He had go to baseball games. He went through a lot of games. He loved baseball. He taught baseball. He read baseball. He wasn't. That was me.

Anything else about him that is... Any of the jobs you played on? You've talked before on the tape from me about Johnny and the different jobs you've had. Is there anything else about him? When did you first meet him? Did you hear him in New Orleans? Did you hear him in New Orleans?
No, I never heard Johnny in New Orleans. I heard Johnny up here at the Royal Garden with King Oliver.
Was he as good the first time you heard him in Mr. Oliver as later when he worked with you?
But those old records you can't always tell about, but I wonder how he found it. Good, good. It was good then.

Very good. And baby was very fast. Very fast. That's what made that record. Baby Dots made that sound like two drums. Them drum solos, you know, you call it just drum. It sounded like two drums to me. But it was baby by himself. Baby was a streak of lightning.
